Subject: Re: Chrono wedge: initial availability windows

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the quick reply on the RFP. Our execs want a short, focused demo (30–40 min) that covers Live inference latency, failover behavior, and private deployment options. We have stakeholders across three regions (US, EU, APAC) and want to minimize the number of people who have to join outside normal working hours.

High-level constraints:
- US (CTO): prefers 09:00–11:00 PT (no earlier)
- EU (Head of Eng): prefers 16:00–18:00 CET
- APAC (VP Ops): cannot be later than 12:00 SGT local time

We tried to map this quickly and it looks like there is a ~30–45 minute overlap around 16:00–17:00 UTC on some days, but DST quirks (EU switches next week) make this messy. Can you propose a few concrete UTC slots and a fallback plan (recording + short follow-up for APAC) if we cannot get all three execs in one call?

Also, attaching a short attendee list (see scheduling contact).

Thanks,
Sylvia Nguyen
Director, Product Strategy
ACME Health

Sylvia — really helpful constraints, thanks. I sketched three concrete options (all in UTC) that try to balance the exec windows and account for the EU DST change next week:

Option A — Single live slot (preferred):
- Tue 2029-05-21 16:00–16:40 UTC (US: 09:00 PT, EU: 17:00 CET, APAC: 00:00 SGT next day) — note APAC is late; only possible if APAC exec can accept a late call

Option B — Single live slot with compact agenda + APAC follow-up:
- Wed 2029-05-22 15:30–16:00 UTC (US: 08:30 PT — bit early for CTO; impact acceptable if 30m), EU: 17:30 CET, APAC: 23:30 SGT — still late for APAC; plan to record and do a 20-min async Q&A in APAC-friendly hours

Option C — Split/short double-handoff (no single overlap):
- Live 1 (US+EU execs): Thu 2029-05-23 16:00–16:30 UTC (US: 09:00 PT, EU: 18:00 CET)
- Live 2 (APAC): Fri 2029-05-24 03:00–03:40 UTC (APAC morning local) — Redwood engineer repeats focused demo for APAC with identical script; recording + Q&A link for US/EU

Tradeoffs: Option A minimizes repeats but forces APAC late. Option C respects local hours but doubles live sessions (short, identical).

Can you confirm which option you'd prefer? If you want Option A or B, which exact dates are best for your execs? We'll prepare a timezone matrix and an ICS stub for the confirmed slot.

Thanks — looping in Priya and Vivek to lock the agenda and confirm who will present which demo segment.

— Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick operational notes from our side:

1) Agenda (30–40m suggested): 8m intros + success metrics, 12m runtime demo (latency/failover/quant), 8m deployment/ops walk-through, 10m Q&A
2) Presenter plan: Logan (runtime demo + failover), Vivek (dedicated/private architecture + SLAs), Kimberly (security/compliance brief)
3) DST: EU goes forward one hour on Sun 2029-05-26; the CET -> CEST change shifts the EU window earlier by an hour starting Mon 2029-05-27. If you want a date after the 27th, adjust EU times accordingly.

Operational ask: If you choose a single live slot (Option A or B), please confirm whether APAC can accept a recording + 20-min live follow-up rather than being present live. That reduces the chance of burn and keeps the core execs in one conversation. If APAC insists on real-time presence, we'll do Option C and make the APAC session short and identical.

I've attached a quick timezone_matrix_v2.xlsx that maps the candidate dates and times with local conversions (includes the DST flip).

— Priya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Head of Eng (EU): can do Wed 2029-05-22 after 16:30 CET but will be unavailable on Thu 2029-05-23 morning
- VP Ops (APAC): strongly prefers a morning slot local time; will accept a recorded walkthrough + 20-min live Q&A in APAC working hours if necessary

- Candidate 1: Tue 2029-05-21 16:00–16:40 UTC (this meets CTO + EU; APAC would be late but could use follow-up)
